sentences.english: I have plenty of money with me.

sentences.japanese: 懐かしきよき昔は過ぎ去ってしまい、２度と帰ってこないでしょう。
sentences.english: The good old days have gone, never to return.

sentences.japanese: 懐かしい昔のことを話すのが好きだ。
sentences.english: I like to talk about the good old days.

sentences.japanese: 加藤氏は、パリに在住していて、家に残した家族を懐かしがっている。
sentences.english: Mr Kato, who lives in Paris, misses his family left at home.

sentences.japanese: その政治家は平然と賄賂を受け取り、全ての契約の５％が濡れ手に粟で彼の懐に入った。
sentences.english: The politician had sticky fingers, and 5% of every contract ended in his pocket.
